data.name: Mujiddah
data.gender_notes: Mujiddah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mujiddah means 'guide' or 'helper'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ajd' which means 'to help'. In Islamic tradition, Mujiddah is a name given to those who guide and help others on their spiritual journey. It is a name full of kindness, wisdom, and trustworthiness. The name Mujiddah carries the meaning “Guide, Helper, Aide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mujiddah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper, aide and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mujiddah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper, Aide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujiddah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
